observer: Codex AI; same overall project reader, not independent expert
visibility_limit: One retained representative photograph per source; a page-side layout is not automatically the layout of the whole fragment.

readings.label: A
readings.note: One broad notated text field in a rotated, damaged view; portions obscured.

readings.label: B
readings.note: One broad notated field; outer right edge may be cropped.

readings.label: C
readings.note: A single visible notated field but the left edge is cropped; a missing second field cannot be excluded.

readings.label: D
readings.note: One broad notated field extends across the visible leaf.

readings.label: E
readings.note: Heavy damage, show-through and obscured edge prevent a reliable complete layout count.

readings.label: F
readings.note: One broad field appears across the split view, although the right edge is cropped.

readings.label: G
readings.note: Heavy damage and folds obscure the layout.

readings.label: H
readings.note: One broad notated field, partly obscured by folds, darkening and later writing.

readings.label: I
readings.note: One continuous broad notated field is visible.
